rejected_rule.statement: A deed granting property to a person and their heirs does not inherently include a prohibition against alienation of that property by the grantee’s descendants unless explicitly stated.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "A grant to a man and his heirs has the same legal effect as a grant to a man without mention of heirs." - Lawrie J. in Tina v. Sadris [1 (1885) 7 S. C. C. 135.]
